title: Not Until Friday
trend: TikTok 'Christmas music is allowed now' (the no-holiday-music-until-after-Thanksgiving rule, then the finally-allowed moment; spotted Nov 10, sound 39.5K videos, Postdom TikTok trends Nov 23 2026; holiday songs Peak on SocialPilot Instagram Reels Nov 17-25 2026, US) as an absurd office rule skit — manager Hank bans all holiday music until the Friday after Thanksgiving; Gloria sneaks it in (humming, a sweater that plays a tune, the keyboard, intern Wyatt whistling) while the office radio narrates; twist: Hank has been practicing a holiday song on the trumpet since July and wants nobody sick of it before his big office debut; button: he plays it now, badly, and the radio brings the rule back
youtube_title: My boss banned holiday music until Friday. The radio and I had other plans 🎄
description:
Hank has one rule at the office: no holiday music until the Friday after Thanksgiving. Gloria has a sweater, a keyboard and an intern who whistles. Hank has a secret in his drawer.

#cartoon #animation #funny #office #shorts
tiktok_caption: no holiday music at work until Friday. we tried. 🎄 #cartoon #animation #funny #office

lines.text: Reminder, everybody. No holiday music in this office until the Friday after Thanksgiving.
Hank, that is three days. I will not survive.
I am the office radio. I have been playing the same weather report since March.
Friday. Twelve noon. Not one second sooner.
Fine. I will be quiet. Like a little snowflake.
She was not quiet like a snowflake. She hummed for nine minutes.
Gloria. Are you humming the one about the sleigh?
No. I am humming about a festive spreadsheet.
Spreadsheets do not go jingle, Gloria.
Mine do. I color the cells red and green.
Plan two. She wore the sweater.
Why is your sweater playing music?
There is a button on the belly. I sat down too hard.
You have sat down too hard eleven times this morning.
My chair is very low, Hank.
The sweater goes in the closet. It can think about what it did.
Hi. I am Wyatt, the intern. Gloria told me to whistle near Hank.
Wyatt! You were the secret plan.
Sorry. I am new.
Wyatt, if you whistle one jingle, you are filing paper until New Year.
I love paper. Is that a threat?
Plan four. She typed the song on her keyboard.
Beep, boop, boop. Beep, boop, boop.
That is not typing. You are typing a song at me.
It is an email. To my mom. She will understand.
Final plan. She asked me directly.
Radio. Please. One little holiday song.
I cannot. Hank put a sticky note on my power button. It says Friday.
Who puts a sticky note on a radio?
A man with a secret. I have seen his bottom drawer.
Radio. We talked about the drawer.
I am the intern. I open drawers.
There is a trumpet in here. And a book called holiday songs for beginners.
Hank. Do you play the trumpet?
Since July. My neighbor moved his bed to the other wall.
He wants to play one song at the office party on Friday.
If you hear it all week, you will be sick of it.
I wanted it to feel new. One moment where everybody smiles at me.
Hank. That is the sweetest rule I have ever been mad at.
Can you play it now? I might not be an intern on Friday.
It is not ready. I only know the beginning. And part of the middle.
Please. Holiday music is allowed now. I am allowing it.
I took the sticky note off myself. I am very brave today.
Okay. Everybody stand back. This is a loud instrument.
He played. It sounded like a goose that found out about taxes.
My ears are filing a complaint.
Hank. That was beautiful. Please never do it again before Friday.
Then I will practice here every night until Friday.
I would like to go back to filing paper. Forever.
Radio, play something. Anything. The weather report. Please.
New office rule. No holiday trumpet until the Friday after Thanksgiving.
That is my rule.
It is my rule now. I put a sticky note on your trumpet.
